notes.title: The game now officially supports Japanese, Spanish, and Portuguese!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561335/36624e7dde4497e92d8c7f196f87fb554d687ca3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Dear players:[/b][/h3][h3]

notes.title: Final Demo released and Kickstarter Campaign is coming!
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561335/b4bdaa9bf7bd2513976ac9c0dc60a8061c1fdd90.png"][/img][/h3][h1]The [b]final version of the demo[/b] is now live![/h1][h3][b]and yes, you can meet Quentin right on Day 1![/b][/h3][h3]Thank you all for your feedback and support!
We’ve made many adjustments and improvements based on your suggestions.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Also, our [b]Kickstarter campaign is launching on June 27![/b]
Come support us and help make the full game even richer and more exciting![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Kickstarter campaign [/b][/h3][h3][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fymmg/those-npcs-love-stories"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fymmg/those-npcs-love-stories[/url][/h3]

notes.title: The game demo is officially released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561335/285e5f6794b23907dd46e596543545d5a22ac8ca.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The game demo of those NPC's love stories is officially released![/b]  [/h3][p]Thank you for your help in reporting many bugs and suggestions, we have fixed the bugs and updated some systems. We hope you will enjoy Ryu's new game.  [/p][p]Free patch DLC will be provided in the official release, but the Steam Demo is the R16 version.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Join us on Discord for more news and live help:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/7rjPtqW6U3"]https://discord.gg/7rjPtqW6U3[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Kickstarter campaign will be launched on 27th June, don't miss it![/b]  [/h3][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fymmg/those-npcs-love-stories"]Those NPC's Love Stories by FYMM GAMING — Kickstarter[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][/h3]
